lastText: Command TerminatedThe Pattern, NoticedMajor DefeatWehrmacht High Command, 1939–1945End of hostilities: PATTERN NOTICEDImmediate AftermathThis campaign ends here, and not on any front. Führer Mode's political ███████ was never the actual ██████: spending it was the mechanic working exactly as intended. The danger was always the pattern underneath the spending: an officer whose file shows this much accumulated independence, however each individual act was justified at the time, is not an officer this regime lets keep a command. There is no single order, no single refusal, that did this. There is only the sum of them, noticed all at once, the way these things were in truth noticed. The war continues under whoever replaces you. It does not pause to explain the replacement.One Year LaterThe war this command no longer ran ends the way it was always going to: in unconditional █████████, under whoever inherited the file. A year on, the tribunal now sitting at Nuremberg has no seat reserved for an officer removed from command before the end–dismissal was not a defense the court recognized for the men who did stay, and it is unlikely to have counted for much in the version of events this branch didn't get to see either.The Theater Map at the end of the warThe map at the end of 1945StartPATTERN NOTICED: The war endsLatestSwedenFinlandDenmarkBritainIrelandFranceBeneluxSwitz.IberiaGermanyPolandCzechiaAustriaHungaryBalticsLeningradN.
